rootCause: One outer transaction held the FK DDL and live_streams journal row locks across every card-update batch.
fix: Commit the short FK switch first; ledger deletes and small keyset card updates autocommit. Retained telemetry is checked in a fixed created_at cohort.
regressionBefore: Previous script fails hot-card transaction-boundary assertion.
regressionAfter: 1002 card rows processed, other card preserved, all versions and both telemetry cohorts retained.
plannedMonitoring: Dedicated observer checks pg_stat_activity/pg_locks every 100ms and before each write; cancels on first observed blocked client/waiting lock.
